invocations.office: PART III: OFFICE FOR THE FEAST OF THE BLESSED HIEROMARTYR JOSAPHAT [^49]
invocations.normalized_rubric: *If it fall on a Sunday, on Saturday at Vespers we chant the kathisma: "Blessed is the man": All of the Resurrection. At "Lord, I have cried", Resurrection Stichera on 4, and to the Saint on 6. But if it fall on another day, we sing the Stichera of the Feast of the Exaltation [of the Cross], and to the Saint, Stichera, Tone 1. Podoben: "As noble among martyrs" (Прихва́льнїи мꙋ́ченицы):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Sticheron 1:* Having stained thy sacred vestment with martyr's blood,...

invocations.office: PART III: OFFICE FOR THE FEAST OF THE BLESSED HIEROMARTYR JOSAPHAT [^49]
invocations.normalized_rubric: *At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8. Podoben: "That which was mystically commanded" (Пове́лѣнное та́йнѡ):* Having forsaken all earthly things, and having lived in the world as an angel in bodily purity, by the Spirit thou wast a communicant of the angels: having mortified present bodily passions, thou appearedst as a servant of the Holy Trinity, O all-blessed one: therefore thou healest the passions of the sick, and drivest away evil spirits by the grace of Christ, O our God-bearing father, Hieromartyr Josaphat: pray unto Christ God, to grant forgiveness of sins unto those who celebrate with love thy holy memory.
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Glory... Now and ever... of the Feast:* Joshua the son...

invocations.office: PART III: OFFICE FOR THE FEAST OF THE BLESSED HIEROMARTYR JOSAPHAT [^49]
invocations.normalized_rubric: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 4. Podoben: "Joseph was amazed" (Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ):* An altar of blood was thy heart hidden within, and bloodless sacrifices celebrating thou didst offer unto God: and thou sufferedst valiantly from ungodly enemies, and having endured multifaceted torments, thou wast offered as an acceptable sacrifice unto Christ our God Who sacrificed Himself for us, O all-blessed Hieromartyr Josaphat, praised by all: Whom earnestly pray evermore, for all who with love hymn thee.
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Glory... Now and ever... of the Feast:* Moses having stretched...

invocations.normalized_rubric: *Glory... Now and ever... of the Feast, Tone 8. Podoben: "That which was mystically commanded" (Пове́лѣнное та́йнѡ):* In paradise of old the tree stripped me bare, by tasting whereof the enemy brought in death; but the Tree of the Cross, bearing the garment of life unto men, was erected upon the earth, and the whole world was filled with all joy: which beholding exalted, with faith let us cry aloud together unto God: Thy house is full of glory!
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *If it be not Sunday, Gradual Antiphon, Tone 4, 1st...

invocations.office: PART III: OFFICE FOR THE FEAST OF THE BLESSED HIEROMARTYR JOSAPHAT [^49]
invocations.normalized_rubric: *Sessional Hymn to the Saint, Tone 4. Podoben: "Speedily anticipate" (Ско́рѡ предварѝ):* Thou didst burn up the deception of schismatics, O Hieromartyr Josaphat; thou didst clarify the faith well by unity, and enlightenedst the world, therefore a wonderworking sufferer didst thou appear, a pillar of the Church, and a true shepherd: pray unceasingly unto Christ, that we all may be saved.
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Ode 4. Heirmos: I have heard, O Lord, the report...

invocations.office: PART III: OFFICE FOR THE FEAST OF THE BLESSED HIEROMARTYR JOSAPHAT [^49]
invocations.normalized_rubric: *Glory...
